system:
You are assembling a clinical visit note. The sentences of one note are listed below in random order. Each sentence carries, in square brackets, the heading it was written under. File every sentence under that heading. In the JSON, the headings are the keys subjective, objective_exam, objective_results and assessment_and_plan. Return each sentence ID under exactly one heading. Do not leave any sentence out and do not invent IDs.

<sentences>
S1 [OBJECTIVE RESULTS]: CT scan of chest, obtained at an outside facility, is reviewed today and demonstrates a solitary 2 cm nodule in the lateral aspect of the right upper lobe.
S2 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: I explained to the patient that his procedure will consist of 3 small incisions being made on the side of his right chest.
S3 [SUBJECTIVE]: He notes that he enjoys biking.
S4 [SUBJECTIVE]: He denies any family history of lung cancer.
S5 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: I will then insert a camera and scope to assist in removing the nodule along with a very small portion of his lung.
S6 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: It could be a benign nodule, but because of his smoking history, I think it is best that he has it surgically removed.
S7 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: Nodule will be removed via video assisted thoracoscopy.
S8 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: - Auscultation of Lungs: Clear and equal bilaterally.
S9 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: He will have a chest tube in until the following day when I remove it at his bedside.
S10 [SUBJECTIVE]: Patient reports taking methotrexate 7.5 mg every week.
S11 [OBJECTIVE RESULTS]: No evidence of any type of emphysematous disease is present.
S12 [SUBJECTIVE]: Respiratory: Denies cough or shortness of breath.
S13 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: Right upper lobe lung nodule.
S14 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: Pulses are intact in all extremities.
S15 [SUBJECTIVE]: Patient reports his mother has a history of breast cancer, but is doing well.
S16 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: Mild swelling to the 3rd digit knuckles on the bilateral hands, consistent with RA.
S17 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: Patient Agreements: The patient understands and agrees with the recommended medical treatment plan.
S18 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: He was advised that he will be admitted for most likely an overnight stay.
S19 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: No clicks, rubs, or murmurs.
S20 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: - Patient Education and Counseling: I encouraged the patient to continue to follow up with his rheumatologist.
S21 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: - Auscultation of Heart: Regular rate and rhythm.
S22 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: - Medical Treatment: Continue medication therapy and routine follow up with rheumatologist as previously outlined.
S23 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: PET CT will also be scheduled to determine if the nodule is metabolically active, which can suggest if it is cancerous or inflammatory.
S24 [SUBJECTIVE]: Patient reports he stopped smoking tobacco 7 years ago and has felt better since doing so.
S25 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: Surgery will require general anesthesia and will take approximately 1.5 hours.
S26 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: - Medical Reasoning: The patient has incidentally found right upper lobe lung nodule visible on his chest CT.
S27 [SUBJECTIVE]: He denies any previous history of lung infections or pneumonia.
S28 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: Capillary refill is brisk.
S29 [SUBJECTIVE]: Patient reports a history of rheumatoid arthritis.
S30 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: - Medical Reasoning: Stable.
S31 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: Rheumatoid arthritis.
S32 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: - Examination: Skin is pink, warm, and dry.
S33 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: - Patient Education and Counseling: I had a thorough discussion with the patient concerning surgical treatment.
S34 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: All questions were answered.
S35 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: - Examination: No lower extremity edema.
S36 [OBJECTIVE RESULTS]: It appears the nodule is smooth in appearance.
S37 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: - Medical Treatment: Pulmonary function test ordered today to obtain patient's baseline.
</sentences>
